body:
@MarcoMartins86 the `qualifier_issue_lib` is probably not indexed and the `NormalEvent` qualifier is not discovered. Could you try to add an empty `src/main/resources/META-INF/beans.xml` file in the lib project?

See also https://quarkus.io/guides/cdi-reference#bean_discovery for more info about Quarkus bean discovery.

Thank you for the suggestion but it did not work. Also, reading the page you mentioned, in the underlined text, if I understand correctly observers should be discovered automatically. 

> Bean classes that don’t have a bean defining annotation are not discovered. This behavior is defined by CDI. But producer methods and fields <ins>and observer methods are discovered even if the declaring class is not annotated with a bean defining annotation (this behavior is different to what is defined in CDI)</ins>. In fact, the declaring bean classes are considered annotated with @Dependent.

> Thank you for the suggestion but it did not work. Also, reading the page you mentioned, in the underlined text, if I understand correctly observers should be discovered automatically.
> 

Yes, but the bean classes, qualifiers, etc. must be indexed by Quarkus first. I'll take a look at the reproducer.

I think I was doing that already by having this on the pom.xml. Thank you again for your time.

```xml
      <plugin>
        <groupId>org.jboss.jandex</groupId>
        <artifactId>jandex-maven-plugin</artifactId>
        <version>${jandex-plugin.version}</version>
        <executions>
          <execution>
            <id>make-index</id>
            <goals>
              <goal>jandex</goal>
            </goals>
          </execution>
        </executions>
      </plugin>
```

I can confirm that it's a bug. 

The Jandex `MethodParameterInfo` does not implement `equals()/hashCode()` and for some reason we receive two distinct target instances for the `@Observes` and `@NormalEvent` annotations declared on the event param of `AbstractObserverNormalEvent.observer()`.

I'll prepare a fix next Monday.

issue.title: ArC - fix the algorithm to find event parameter qualifiers
issue.body:
- the Jandex MethodParameterInfo does not implement equals()/hashCode()
and annotations declared on a parameter of the same method may have
different MethodParameterInfo target instances
- resolves #15886

body: @MarcoMartins86 FYI the problem only occurs if an observer method is declared on a class located in an archive with a pregenerated Jandex index (e.g. via the jandex-maven-plugin).
